sections.heading: For each distinct {{entity_noun}} you identify, this must hold:

rules.text: The {{entity_noun}} you identified is one the phrase and its relationship summary support the manufacturer itself {{entity_relationships.gerund}}.

sections.heading: The option you match it to must qualify:

rules.text: The option is chosen by comparing underlying meanings and definitions with the identified {{entity_noun}}, not by lexical or name similarity, and without forced or contrived links that rely on assumptions beyond the phrase and its relationship summary.

children.text: In particular, do not choose an option whose name resembles the identified {{entity_noun}} when the option's definition excludes this case.

sections.heading: Match each {{entity_noun}} you identified by the first of these rules that applies, in order:

rules.text: An option whose meaning exactly matches the identified {{entity_noun}} is chosen.
When no option exactly matches, an option whose meaning generalizes the identified {{entity_noun}} is chosen.
When no option exactly matches or generalizes the identified {{entity_noun}}, the identified {{entity_noun}} is proposed as an option of its own.

children.text: Unless the proposed option restates the meaning of an existing option under different words; in that case that existing option is chosen instead.
